BrochureContent.Content:
Fenelon Properties are delighted to present No. 16 Marlton Demesne to the market. This spacious four-bedroom detached family home extends to approximately 142 sq.m. and is ideally positioned within one of Wicklow Town's most established and sought-after residential developments.
Presented in good condition throughout, the property offers bright, well-proportioned accommodation designed to suit modern family living. A particular feature is the converted garage, currently used as a home office/gym, providing valuable additional reception space with excellent flexibility for a variety of uses including a playroom, home office or fifth bedroom.
The accommodation briefly comprises a welcoming entrance hall with guest WC, a spacious living room with bay window, feature open fireplace and double doors opening to the kitchen/dining room. The kitchen is fitted with an extensive range of maple units and benefits from French doors opening directly onto the spacious, fan shaped rear garden, creating an excellent connection between indoor and outdoor living. A separate utility room provides additional storage and practicality.
Upstairs there are four well-proportioned bedrooms, including a generous main bedroom complete with fitted wardrobes, bay window and ensuite shower room. A fully fitted family bathroom serves the remaining bedrooms.
One of the standout features of No. 16 is the impressive rear garden. The generous lawn provides an ideal setting for children to play, outdoor entertaining or future landscaping, while the detached garden shed offers excellent storage for tools and garden equipment. To the front, the property enjoys off-street parking with a private driveway and mature planting.
Marlton Demesne is a mature and highly regarded residential development located just minutes from Wicklow Town Centre. Residents enjoy easy access to a wide range of amenities including supermarkets, cafés, restaurants, schools, sporting facilities and both bus and rail transport links. The nearby N11 also provides an easy commute to Dublin and surrounding areas.
Offering generous living accommodation, an excellent family layout and a superb rear garden, No. 16 represents an outstanding opportunity to acquire a quality detached home in a prime Wicklow Town location.

Viewing is highly recommended.
